{{Quote|Captain Serros, systems are coming back online. The hyperdrive is operational!|A [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|clone naval officer]] to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Serros]], on the status of the ''Guardian''{{'s}} repairs.|<ref name="CWA" />}}
The '''''Guardian''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] employed by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Under the command of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Serros]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] engaged the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] fleet and was crippled in the battle. Though severely damaged, with the help of a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi General]], the ''Guardian'' managed to repel its attackers and its crew were able to repair enough of the damages to escape to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="CWA" />

==Description==
The ''Guardian'' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] that served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Marked with red colors, the ''Guardian'' was equipped with [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], and [[Gravity generator/Legends|gravity generators]]. It also featured a pair of [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command towers]] and eight [[Engine/Legends|engines]].<ref name="CWA" />

==History==
{{Quote|Sir, our ship is currently adrift with all major systems disabled. General Grievous is landing droids in order to try and take it over.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Serros]] informing a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] on the situation of the [[Guardian]].|<ref name="CWA" />}}
The ''Guardian'' was placed under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Serros]] during the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict between the Republic and the forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="CWA" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SWA">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> during the Clone Wars, the ''Guardian'' was stationed in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and was engaged in a battle with the [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Separatist Supreme Commander]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], where it was heavily damaged. In response, a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi General]] was dispatched to aid the crippled [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]], only to learn upon arrival that Grievous was attempting to take the cruiser with a large number of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] forcefully boarding the [[Starship/Legends|ship]].<ref name="CWA" />

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] issued orders to the ''Guardian''{{'s}} [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] crew to errect defenses along the ship's damaged [[Hull/Legends|hull]]; the ''Guardian''{{'s}} [[Gravity generator/Legends|gravity generators]] were even converted into a weapon capable of slowing the advancing [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The Jedi's plan was a success, and the constructed defenses held firm against the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Droid Navy's]] assault, allowing Republic [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] the [[Time/Legends|time]] they needed to repair the ''Guardian''{{'s}} [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="CWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic ''Venator''-class Cruiser, ''Guardian'', first appeared in the [[Sony]] Online Entertainment massively multi-player online game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|Clone Wars Adventures]] in the Republic Defender stage "Adrift."<ref name="CWA" />
